info.title: Groundtruth Reporting API
info.description:
**External reporting API.**  

 *Note:* All REST API endpoints currently require HTTP/1.1. Please use HTTP/1.1 (e.g., by adding `--http1.1` in curl commands) to receive a response.

get.summary: Get Location data
get.description: Get Location data

parameters.name: location_type
parameters.description: flag to get data for the campaign by location_type

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: flag to get the data sorted by given metric, default is impressions

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: set to 1 to get top 10 records descending by given metric, set to 2 to get top 10 records ascending by given metric, set to 0 for all records with ascending ordering by given metric.
